inputs.resume_text:
Harsh Agarwal
PGP 2025-27, Indian Institute of Management Lucknow | harsh.agarwal@iiml.ac.in

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS
PGP, IIM Lucknow, 2025-27, CGPA 6.9/10
B.Com, Narsee Monjee College of Commerce, Mumbai, 2020, 71%

WORK EXPERIENCE (36 months)
Agarwal Textiles Pvt Ltd (family business), Surat | Business Development Lead | Jul 2021 - Jun 2024
- Opened 3 new export markets (Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, UAE) for synthetic sarees; export share grew from 4% to 19% of revenue in 2 years
- Moved 140 retail dealers from paper orders to a WhatsApp-based ordering catalogue; order processing time dropped from 3 days to same day
- Negotiated yarn contracts worth INR 22 crore a year with 2 Reliance-linked suppliers
Agarwal Textiles, Trainee | Jul 2020 - Jun 2021

SUMMER INTERNSHIP
Asian Paints | Sales and Distribution Intern, Nagpur | Apr - Jun 2026
- Mapped 210 painters and 64 dealers in 3 tier-3 towns; designed a painter-loyalty referral scheme that brought 31 new painters into the program in 6 weeks
- Identified that 40% of dealer stock-outs were in 12 fast-moving SKUs and proposed a weekly top-up route; pilot reduced lost orders by an estimated INR 9 lakh a month
- Received PPO

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Coordinator, Sales and Marketing Club (Markathon), IIM Lucknow
- Captain, college cricket team, NMCC (2018-19)

plan.warmup_question: Which recent skill from your MBA has been most useful so far?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your career so far, with a focus on your last couple of roles.

slots.core_question: Tell me about the painter-loyalty referral scheme you designed during your Asian Paints internship.
slots.intent_private: Needs the customer insight behind the scheme, Harsh's specific decisions, how he influenced painters or dealers, and how the 31 new painters were verified.
likely_probes: Which decision in the scheme was yours alone?
What did you do first to persuade painters to join?
What was the baseline for the 31 new painters?

slots.core_question: How did you lead the NMCC college cricket team as captain?
slots.intent_private: Needs a specific team situation, Harsh's people decisions, how he handled differing performance or commitment levels, and the resulting team outcome.
likely_probes: What was the first leadership challenge you faced as captain?
Which decision about a teammate was yours to make?
How did you know your approach improved the team?

slots.core_question: How would you decide whether to expand a dealer network into a new tier-3 market?
slots.intent_private: Needs a practitioner-level approach using market potential, dealer economics, route feasibility and customer demand, with a clear trade-off between growth and execution cost.
likely_probes: Why would you prioritise that information over another signal?
When would you decide not to enter the market?
How would you validate the decision using your own market-development experience?

slots.core_question: You have built sales experience in your family business and at Asian Paints. What is pulling you toward sales and business development now?
slots.intent_private: Needs a reason tied to Harsh's own commercial experience, a specific attraction to this type of role, and a credible explanation of what he wants to build next.
likely_probes: Which experience most shaped that choice?
What part of this role would you want to take on first?

plan.plan_notes: The plan prioritizes the relevant Asian Paints internship, then tests people leadership through a substantial extracurricular role and sales judgment through an applied market-development question. Harsh has a strong, quantified resume with unusually broad exposure to export expansion, dealer digitization and commercial negotiations; the family-business background makes motivation toward the next sales role worth clarifying.
